resource.title: Reader display
resource.description: How plugin widgets and start confirmations behave on Attractap readers

noScreenPolicy.label: Readers without a screen
noScreenPolicy.description: What happens when a plugin asks for a confirmation on a reader that cannot show it: Lite readers, readers with older firmware and readers paused after repeated crashes. "Confirm with a second card tap" works on Lite readers only; other readers without a screen block the start. "Start with a warning" starts without a confirmation.

description.breaker-open: {{plugin}} failed to check several starts in a row, so it is no longer asked. Until it answers again, starts follow the "If the plugin's check fails" setting of each resource. The plugin is asked again automatically after 60 seconds; Clear asks it right away. If this keeps happening, check the plugin's log or disable the plugin.
description.load-failure: {{plugin}} could not be loaded, so its start checks and confirmations are not applied and starts go ahead without them. Check the plugin's error on this page and reload or reinstall it. The alert ends when the plugin loads again.
description.crash-loop: {{reader}} crashed repeatedly, so plugin widgets are paused on it and confirmations there follow the resource's "Readers without a screen" setting. Widgets return after 30 minutes without another crash, or right away with Clear. If it keeps crashing, update the reader's firmware or report the crash.
